scope: exploratory dev fresh-process complete rollouts; no snapshot counterfactual or independent test
stopping_rule: complete all 40 scheduled attempts; stop on infrastructure/provenance failure; no outcome-based early stopping or replacement
invalid_rule: retain every attempt; show valid-trial and scheduled-attempt denominators; do not label invalid attempts physical task failures
claim_rule: descriptive dev evidence only; snapshot gate remains unchanged; no full self-evolution claim from single-skill SAC
